name: Acceptance Criteria
producesProse: Testable criteria per requirement, definition of done.

exitCriteria.describe: Criteria are objective — pass/fail without judgment calls.

purpose: State, per requirement, what would make it demonstrably done without a judgment call.

method.summary: Write one testable criterion per requirement and check that each reads pass or fail on its own.
steps: Author one acceptance criterion per requirement, stated so it reads pass or fail without a judgment call.
Ask the operator about any requirement whose done-ness cannot be stated objectively.
Trace each criterion to the requirement it verifies.
Set each criterion the operator accepts to approved.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a blocking question first; author or revise while any requirement lacks an objective criterion; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: A criterion needing judgment to evaluate is not a criterion.
A requirement with no criterion is not covered.

approvalBoundary.approves: That each criterion is objective, by the operator.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: The definition of done for this project.
